## The story

A data center has moved in next door. Its diesel backup generators have to be
tested, and every test hour is money to the operator and noise to the
neighbor. One of you runs the data center (Player A), one of you lives next
door (Player B). You will bargain in real time over generator hours and a
payment, and who holds the property right changes by round.

## Online game links

- Student login: [Student Portal](/games/coase-online/student.html)
- Admin login (instructor): [Admin Dashboard](/games/coase-online/admin.html)

## How we will play

- Join the Student Portal with a player name.
- The instructor starts random pairing. You keep the same partner and role
  for all three rounds. If the class size is odd, one student bargains with
  an instructor proxy that accepts any offer.
- Each round runs against a countdown. Bargain inside the app: put an offer
  on the table, counter your partner's, accept, reject, or walk away.
- If the clock runs out with no deal, the round ends at the status quo: the
  rights holder picks their favorite hours and no payment changes hands.

## Payoff schedule

Payoffs are in hundred thousand dollars per month and generator hours are
per week.

| Generator hours | Operator (A) payoff | Resident (B) payoff |
|:---------------:|:-------------------:|:-------------------:|
| 0               | 0                   | 12                  |
| 1               | 4                   | 10                  |
| 2               | 6                   | 6                   |
| 3               | 6                   | 4                   |
| 4               | 9                   | 2                   |
| 5               | 10                  | 1                   |
| 6               | 11                  | 0                   |

An accepted deal pays the agreed payment from the noncontroller to the
controller on top of these payoffs.

## Round 1

- The operator (A) holds the property right: no deal means 6 hours.
- The resident can pay the operator to cut hours.

## Round 2

- The resident (B) holds the property right: no deal means 0 hours.
- The operator can pay the resident to allow hours.

## Round 3

- Same rights as Round 2, but any accepted deal with a positive payment
  triggers legal drafting costs of 5, split between A and B as part of the
  offer. Think hard about whether a deal is still worth it.

## Tips

- The offer preview shows both payoffs before you commit; use it.
- Your total across all three rounds goes on the class leaderboard.
- Walking away is final for the round, and the confirm button means it.
